*Originally shared on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7445624158765346816/) on 2 April 2026 in New York (3 April 2026 UTC, the date used here).*

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
[Download the PDF](moving-notes-to-typst.pdf).
:::

I barely know what Typst is. What I do know is that it comes bundled with Quarto (hence Positron/RStudio), requires very little change to my markdown code, yet compiles much, much faster than LaTeX.

With a few tweaks here and there, I migrated the construction site that contains most of the various "notes" I've posted to LinkedIn from LaTeX to Typst today. Some Band-Aid code was eliminated and I think the PDFs even look better: [Notes and PDFs](https://iangow.github.io/notes/)

More "notes" are here (most with links to PDFs): [Blog archive](https://iangow.github.io/notes/blog.html)

::: {.callout-note icon=false}
## Update - 27 October 2026

The links above now lead to the maintained notes collection and chronological archive. The [Quarto sources](https://github.com/iangow/notes) record the output format for each note in its `.qmd` file.
:::
